items.title: How to Run an Embedding Model on Bare Metal
items.summary: Running vector search on the edge is something we’ve been working towards here at Qdrant.The main problem is that vector search is resource-hungry, starting with the embedding step: EmbeddingGemma-2, a small modern model, takes up 310MB of memory when quantized to 8 bits, while Qwen3 Embedding 4B, a larger one, needs 4.28GB. Size is just one side of the coin: transformer-based inference involves expensive computations and often relies on heavy dependencies like PyTorch (or libtorch).
items.creator: info@qdrant.tech (Andrey Vasnetsov)
